name: focus-grid
title: Focus Grid
description: A grid of picture cards where the one you point at or tab to stays bright and the others step back. It helps a reader compare a few visual options (destinations, case studies, chapters) without the grid feeling busy.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/focus-grid

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/focus-grid.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/focus-grid';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/focus-grid

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
